report:
**Conclusion:** Your skepticism is partly justified if the claim means that simply adding olive oil, by itself, has been proven to prevent stroke. The evidence is suggestive, not definitive. But the overall claim is not false: higher olive-oil intake is associated with lower stroke risk, and one major randomized dietary trial supports a causal benefit from a Mediterranean diet supplemented with extra-virgin olive oil.

**Evidence supporting the claim**

* A 2014 systematic review/meta-analysis of cohort studies found that higher olive-oil intake (unlike monounsaturated fat from all sources) was significantly associated with lower stroke risk. Cohort studies can adjust for smoking, diet, activity, etc., but cannot fully exclude “healthy-user” confounding: olive-oil consumers may differ in other health-relevant ways.  
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC4198773/

* The French Three-City prospective study specifically examined incident stroke in older adults and tested both reported olive-oil use and plasma oleic acid (an imperfect intake marker). Its objective and findings support an inverse association, but it was observational and had relatively few strokes, so it cannot establish causation.  
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/21676914/

* Stronger evidence comes from the reanalyzed PREDIMED randomized trial: 7,447 Spanish adults aged 55–80 at elevated cardiovascular risk, but without cardiovascular disease, were assigned to a Mediterranean diet supplemented with extra-virgin olive oil, the same diet with nuts, or low-fat-diet advice. Major cardiovascular events—including stroke—were lower in both Mediterranean-diet groups. However, this tested a dietary pattern plus supplementation, not olive oil isolated from the rest of the diet, and applies most directly to similar high-risk adults.  
https://www.nejm.org/doi/full/10.1056/NEJMoa1800389

**Bottom line:** Replacing butter or other saturated fats with olive oil within a Mediterranean-style diet is reasonable and plausibly lowers stroke risk. Do not treat olive oil as a stand-alone stroke-prevention treatment or assume that more added calories/oil is automatically beneficial.
